reason: The purchase line describes a 300 W 40 V brushed motor, but no candidate matches: MTR-75173 is 400 W 20 V, MTR-75169 is 400 W 18 V brushless, and MTR-75168 is 200 W 12 V, so the 300 W/40 V rating conflicts with every candidate and the part number MTR-75180 belongs to a family member outside this BOM set.
